card.name: The digit 6 in phone numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 6 inside a telephone number, most often the second digit after 1-8 in toll-free numbers (1-866) given as a contact line. Also seen in other phone, fax and ISBN digit strings.

modes.label: Toll-free 1-866 numbers
modes.description: The 6 right after 1-8 in a toll-free contact number in a drug label.

modes.label: Other phone or ID digits
modes.description: A 6 within a UK phone number, fax number or ISBN.
modes.example: 1BD Tickets: £6.50, £4.50 concession, available from The Oxford Playhouse on 018<<6>>5 305305

card.plain: It lights up on the digit 6 in the middle of a phone number, especially 1-866 toll-free lines.
